name: twin strikes
effect: Once per turn, when you do an Attack you may spend 2 Strain or Empowered to do another Attack with the same Attack Sum.

name: defender
effect:
When you hit a target with Melee Attack you may spend 1 Strain or Empowered to have them be Rooted until the start of your next turn.
Additionally, once per Break or Rest, refund 3 Strain when you lose all of your SHIELDING.

name: vigilant
effect: You cannot be surprised while you are keeping watch and may swap your Initiative value with another willing creature's.

name: battle ready
effect:
At the end of a Break or Rest you may perform a ritual. Then, choose one of the following benefits to gain at the beginning of your next combat:
- You have +2 on Initiative.
- Lock a 6.
- You are Empowered for BODY turns.

name: whirlwind
effect:
You can move through dense crowds, or tiles that are occupied by creatures as if it was Rough Terrain.
Additionally, once per turn, refund 3 Strain when you do a Melee Attack against 2 or more creatures in a turn.

name: braced for impact
effect:
When you Hunker Down you take 1 less damage from Attacks (to a minimum of 1).
At the start of your turn, if you took damage since your last turn, refund 2 Strain.

name: melee weapon master
effect:
When you wield a Melee Weapon you get a bonus based on its type:
- **One Handed**: +1 to the Bonus threshold (from 7 to 8).
- **Two Handed**: Attacks gain 2 Reaching (or +1 Reaching if it has Reaching
- **Side**: You may give a 6 instead of ## for an Attack. This Attack gains +2 to its sum.
- **Hammer**: You may have the target go Prone instead of applying Knockback.

name: guarding presence
effect: While you are Hunkered Down your non-area Arts have +3 range.

name: true strikes
effect:
When you give a 12 on a Melee Attack you do not gain the Weapon Downside.
When you give a 8 or less on a Melee Attack you are unaffected by Blind

name: total defence
effect: You gain Resistance to Physical damage, and may spend Strain instead of loosing health or shielding.

name: trained medic
effect: When you use a Bandage you may spend ## and the Bandage to heal 2d4+[BODY or MIND] (Instead of 1+1d4).

name: escapist
effect: When you roll a 3 or less on a Check, Contest, or Dodge roll (before bonuses) gain +1 on your next Check, Contest, or Dodge roll.

name: athlete
effect: You are not Slowed when climbing or swimming and if you willingly move 2 times in a turn gain Warded until the end of your next Turn.

name: momentum
effect: After you willingly move you gain +1 Speed, to a maximum of your BODY, until the end of your turn.

name: last wind
effect: Once per Break or Rest you may choose to gain +1d4 on a Check, heal 2+BODY, or refund 2+BODY Strain.

name: field tending
effect: At the end of a Break you may roll a number of d4 equal to your [BODY or MIND]. You pick any number of Creatures you can see. Heal a total amount of health equal to the dice rolled. The healing may be given to one creature or divided as among several. You cannot target Undead or Constructs.
When you would lose Focus (such as going unconscious or gaining a stack of Death's Door) you may spend 2 Strain to not lose Focus.

name: medical professional
effect: All of your healing effects heal for an additional +1. Additionally, once per Rest, when you heal a creature you may remove a stack of Death's Door from them.

name: surgeon
effect: When you heal a creature, activate a non-damaging Art, or give Empowered or Warded: you or the target may refund 1 Strain. Additionally, your healing may reattach limbs or permanently modify the appearance of the creature.

name: snake eyes
effect: Once per turn, when you roll 2 ones (Snake Eyes), you refund 1 Strain and may spend 1 Strain to re-roll them.

name: patient
effect: At the end of your turn (10 seconds) increase your Locked Dice by 1, to a maximum of 6. If you do not have a Locked dice Lock a 1.

name: acute memory
effect:
You can spend 1 minute to perfectly memorize something. You do not need to do a MIND roll when trying to recall this information. 
You also always know the approximate time, what paths you took to get here, and have +1d4 against memory altering effects (such as from the Art 'Deja Vu').

name: multitasking
effect: You may Lock an additional dice.
When you activate a non-damaging effect against a creature within 3 tiles of you, you may swap places with them. (This is not a teleport.)

name: eggs in one basket
effect: You do not lose unspent dice at the end of your turns. Unused dice, up to a maximum of 2xMIND, may be kept and used on your next turn. These dice are not Locked and cannot be Locked until the start of your next turn.

name: forethought
effect:
When you Lock a dice while already having a Locked dice you may instead add the new dice to the Locked dice's value. This cannot set the locked dice value to be higher than 6.
Additionally, once per turn, when you Lock a 1 or 6 refund 1 Strain.

name: mastermind
effect: You may Lock an additional dice.

name: (tempname) aikido
effect:
When you successfully Dodge a roll or win a contest you did not initiate Lock a 1. 
Additionally, once per turn, you may activate an Art by using a Locked Dice. This Art must cost only one dice and is classified as a Reaction.
extra: Things that make an Art cost # instead of ## can let this trait activate; such as 'Art Manipulator'.

name: covering fire
effect: When you make two or more Attacks against a target in a turn they have -1 Speed and -1 on Contests until the end of their next turn.

name: tag team
effect:
At the end of your turn, Mark all targets you damaged this turn until the start of your next turn.
Once per round, if a Marked target dies or goes unconscious or the Marked is spent you refund 2 Strain.
Additionally, you may spend a Locked Dice to move Marked from one creature you can see to another you can see.

name: make a plan
effect: Spend an hour or more making a plan with others. For each creature who helped make the plan (including yourself) gain a Planned token. You may then spend a Planned token to give a creature Advantage on a Check or Contest. You lose all tokens at the end of your next Rest.

name: mentor
effect: When you Help someone you may Empower them instead of giving a bonus to the roll. (You must have a positive value in the Stat to Help.)

name: coordinated strike
effect: When you Attack a target and remove Marked, pick an ally to do a Melee Attack against the same target (they must be in range). They use the same Attack Sum.

You may spend a # or a Locked Dice to move Marked from one creature you can see to another you can see.
Additionally, when a Marked creature dies or becomes unconscious, you become Empowered until the end of your next turn.

name: threat assessment
effect: When you Mark a target, Mark an additional target you can see for the same duration.

name: warning signs
effect: Spend 2 strain to Mark an Attacking target. When a Marked creature does an Attack you may remove Marked to reduce the Attack Sum by 1.

name: soul covenant
effect:
Make a pact, oath, or pledge to a powerful entity. (A god, demon, dragon, eldritch being, etc.) Work with your GM to create this covenant. For example, a god may ask you to 'Protect the forest.', or a demon may want you to 'Sacrifice a soul every day!'. Should you fail to keep your covenant you may lose access to this Trait.
Pick any Art of Tier 3 or less (regardless of if you have the Architype). Once per Rest, you can offer something to your Patron to activate this Art without spending Strain. For example, a god may ask for a prayer, or a demon may ask for blood.

name: soul bound relic
effect: At the end of a Rest you may bind a small item to your soul. While a creature is holding or wearing the Relic you may cast spells that target only them (or items they are carrying) as if you were able to touch them or be 1 tile away from them.

name: boon infusion
effect: When you spend Strain to activate a non-Attack Art you may spend 1 Strain to give the affected target(s) Warded or Empowered for up to 1 hour. This bonus is given after the Art's effects.

name: soul blade
effect: Turn a Melee Weapon you wield into your Soul Weapon. This weapon does damage equal to 1+SOUL or if it's two handed 3+SOUL, has Returning, can Glow, and cannot be broken except by Arts.

name: soul tempo
effect: When you spend 3 or more Strain in a turn gain Empowered until the end of your next turn (~20 seconds).

name: powered alignment
effect:
While you are Empowered, you have +1 Speed and +1 on Weapon Attack Sums.
While you are Warded, you refund 1 Strain at the end of your turn and may give Glow on targets you touch or hit.

name: boon's protection
effect: Once per turn, you may turn Warded into Empowered or Empowered into Warded. They keep their origional duration.

name: power from within
effect: Arts you or an ally activate that affect just you or items you wield, cost 1 less Strain, to a minimum of 1.

name: purified soul
effect: When you die, instead you turn into a Spirit. While as a Spirit you have the Undead tag, have half health, are permanently Slowed, +1 Dodge against non-Art Attacks, can move through non-metal walls, and cannot carry or use items. If you die as a Spirit you cannot be resurrected. When your body is resurrected you must be present or it will fail.

name: curse
effect: At the end of a Break or Rest you may give a Curse to a creature that you have a part of (hair, nails, skin, etc.). This Curse gives -1 to a Stat (non-stacking), -1d6 on CHARM rolls against you, have a rain cloud above them constantly making them Wet, or you can create your own curse no stronger than these options. The curse ends when they are blessed, you die, they die, or by an effect that removes magic.

name: hex
effect: When you activate a targeted non-Focus Art you may Focus on the Art for up to 1 minute, save any dice spent. At the beginning of your turn you may re-activate the Art on the same target with the same dice sum by spending half the Art's Strain cost (rounded up, to a minimum of 1).

name: death's eyes
effect: While your eyes are closed or you are Blind you can see wisps of the dead. At the end of a Rest these wisps give you +1d4 on your choice of specific Check until your next Rest. (Some examples are, animal handling, religion, or deciphering text.)

name: grave research
effect:
All your created or summoned Followers may gain the Monstrosity or Undead tag. When you create or summon a Monstrosity or Undead you may spend 1 Strain to have them gain one of the following bonuses: Bloody, Ghostly, or Decaying.
- **Bloody:**  They can move through spaces 1 tile smaller than themselves and gain +1 on Grapple rolls.
- **Ghostly:** They gain the 'Spirit Walk' Art and their Attacks do Essence damage instead of their default type. 
- **Decaying:** They take -1 damage from Physical and Essence damage, but have -1 Speed. (Minimum of 1 for damage and Speed.)

name: blood sacrifice
effect: When you do an Attack you may spend 2 Health (ignores Shielding) to increase any damage by 1d4.

name: group practice
effect: When you Focus on an Art that targets ally or yourself you may give the Art's effects to an additional creature. (That creature must be a valid target for the Art.)

At the end of a Rest you may create a Mount Follower. Describe your Mount and how you created it. This Mount has 3xSOUL Max Health, 9 Speed, 0 in all other stats, the Construct, Monstrosity, or Undead tag, and one of the following bonuses (this can be changed at the end of a Rest):
- The Mount can Fly and Hover
- The Mount can move through non-metal walls (taking its rider with it) but has 6 Speed (instead of 9).
- The Mount is Resistant to Physical, and Elemental damage.

name: necromancer
effect: Followers you create or summon have +1 damage while they are within 6 tiles of you, and your Undead Followers can be healed by your Traits and Arts (Not by a Medkit or Bandage).

name: art token
effect: You may spend Strain to activate an Art you know, turning the activation into a Token of your choosing. Later a creature can spend ### destroying the Token to activate the imbued Art without spending Strain. You may have up to ARCANA number of Tokens at a time.

name: art manipulator
effect:
When you activate an Art you may spend 1 Strain then pick 1 of the following:
- The Arts effects happen at a later time based on a specific trigger.
- An Art requires 1 less dice to cast. Use a 3 for the missing dice value.
- An Art activates without any noticeable movement or sounds.

name: flexible repertoire
effect: At the end of a Rest you may swap one of your Arts for a different Art.

name: familiar
effect:
At the end of a Rest create a Familiar Follower. The Familiar has 2xLEVEL Max Health and Strain, +1 Dodge, 7 Speed, 1 in a Main-Stat (Body, Mind, or Soul), 2 in one Sub-Stat of your choice, and 0 for all other Stats. They know the Art 'telepathy' and have a Spectral Attack ('Mage Gauntlets'), You may pick its type (Animal, Construct, Monstrosity, Planar, or Undead), two Tier 1 Arts of your choice (it needs the stat in order to take an Art), and appearance each time it is created.
- When you gain a stat increase the Familiar gains +1 in a Sub-Stat of your choice. You may only ever have 1 Familiar at a time, if you were to create a Familiar while one already exists the first one morphs into the new one.

The familiar improves as you do gaining the following benefits when you hit certain Tiers.
- *Tier 2* - You may pick one Tier 2 Art of your choice for the Familiar.
- *Tier 3* - Choose one (you cannot change this choice later). The Familiar can Fly, gain 1 Art you know, or gain +1 to a Main Stat.
- *Tier 4* - You may pick three Tier 1 Arts and two Tier 2 Arts of your choice for the Familiar.

name: magical knowledge
effect: You learn 2 additional Arts of your choice that you meet the requirements for.

name: art augmenter
effect:
When you activate an Art you may spend 2 Strain then pick 1 of the following:
- An Art with Range has its range doubled. Art's with a range of Touch have Reaching 2.
- Change any Statuses given by an Art to either 2 Burn, Wet, Marked, Charmed, 1 Stun, Warded, or Empowered. It lasts for the same duration as the original Status (or until end of turn).
- Arts that deal damage do an additional 2 damage.

name: signature art
effect:
When you take this Trait choose an Art you know. You may activate that Art up to your SOUL times per Break or Rest without spending Strain.
You cannot change this chosen Art except through extremely powerful sources, and if you remove this Art from your known Arts you cannot use this Trait.

name: art ???
effect:
When you activate an Art you may spend 3 Strain then pick 1 of the following:
- Non-area Arts can have a second target. (Focusing on both effects if needed)
- Arts with an area can be compressed to give a target the effect 3 times (rolling dodge/contests 3 times).
- When you activate an Art that has an area effect, you may choose any number of targets that are not affected by the Art.

name: stacking arts
effect: When you activate an Art you may activate a different Art with the same triggers or conditions on the same target without spending more dice (you still spend Strain). For instance you may activate the Arts 'Cleave' and 'Smite' on the same Weapon Attack.

name: imbuement
effect: At the end of a Rest you may imbue a non-Attack Art you know into a target. The target then has the Art's effect active on them until your next Rest. This Art does not cost Strain or Dice, does not require Focus, has a duration lasting until your next Rest, and can be re-activated ARCANA times per Rest on the target without spending Dice or Strain.

name: show, don't tell
effect: Whenever you speak or do a performance you can subtly add a message into it. You may target any number of creatures you can see to learn the message. Then the creature(s), and only the creature(s), will learn your message regardless of distance.
Up to CHARM times per Rest, you may give a creature that can see or hear you +1d4 on a Check or Contest.

name: i know a guy
effect:
When you are in a jam, describe someone your character would know. Give them a name, say how you think they could be useful, and choose one fact from below:
- They owe me a favor, but they'll be hard to find. 
- They're going to ask for something in exchange. 
- They're always in a great deal of trouble. 
- We used to be together. It's a long story. 
- We didn't part on great terms.
When an ally within 3 tiles of you gains Cloaked, Empowered, or Warded, you may also gain it until the end of your next turn (20 seconds).

name: lead them along
effect: When you win a CHARM contest against a creature you gain +1 on your next CHARM contest against them.

name: hidden in plain sight
effect:
You may use CHARM instead of THIEVING when doing stealth rolls as part of a crowd or to hide your identity.
Additionally, you get Advantage when looking for someone in a crowd.

name: saving face
effect: When you do a CHARM roll you may spend 2 Strain to gain +1d4 to the roll. This may be done after seeing the value but before results are announced.

name: magnetic personality
effect: When you win a CHARM Contest against a creature you may steal any Locked Dice they have. Locking it yourself if you have space or just removing it if you don't.

name: nature preserve
effect: At the start of your turn you may Focus on targeting a point within 9 tiles of you. Everything within 3 tiles of the point becomes your Territory. At the start of your turn or whenever a creature enters this Territory you may spend a Locked Dice to activate a single target Art against them. Use 3+# for any sums. (This Art still costs Strain.)

name: wildshape
effect:
Spend 1 Strain to change into a new animal form. This must be of an animal you know of (though you don't need to have encountered it) and cannot be much larger than yourself (though it may be smaller). This change lasts until you dismiss it, gain stacks of Death's Door, or your next Break or Rest. While in this form you must use a Bite ('Dagger'), Claws ('Mace'), or a Ram Attack ('Club'), cannot use Items or Arts that target anything other than yourself (Weapon Attack Arts still can be used), and gain abilities that would relate to that animal. For example, a spider can climb walls and spin webs, while a bird can fly.
- Your Health, Shielding, Dodge, Strain, Stats, and other Traits remain unchanged.
Additionaly, when you transform you may spend 3 additional Strain to transform into a Large/Huge animal (2x2 or 3x3) gaining 2 Reaching, +2 damage on Attacks, and -1 Dodge.

name: local grove
effect: While you take a Break or Rest you can turn everything within 9 tiles of you into a miniature Grove. In this Grove targets of your choice are Obscured from creatures outside the Grove, can't be detected by magic, and gain +1d4 for Sences rolls.

name: herbal medicine
effect: When you heal a creature pick one additional benefit: +1d6 healing, give 1 Speed,  or give Warded until the end of the healed creatures next turn.

name: shifting winds
effect: Once per turn, you may spend 1 Strain to move effects that target an area up to 3 tiles. This can move effects outside of their normal maximum range.

name: naturespeak
effect: You are able to talk to plants and animals as though they were people. You may use Presence instead of Awareness when rolling Handling and can overhear conversations they may have. (This does NOT make them intelligent only lets you speak with them.)

name: floral
effect:
At the end of a Rest pick Grow, Wither, or Harvest.
- **Grow:** Your Arts that affect an area have +1 to the radius. When you heal a creature with Wet, you heal an extra 1d4.
- **Wither:** Creatures that are affected by Arts that have an area do -1 damage on Attacks, and you may spend 1 Strain to give them -1d4 on a check or contest.
- **Harvest:** Once per turn, when you damage a creature with an Art, you may heal 2 health or gain Empowered until the end of your turn.

name: natural energies
effect: Once per turn, when you or your Followers target a creature give them Empowered, NATURE Bonus Shielding, 2 Stun, Slowed, or apply NATURE Knockback. These effects last until the beginning of your next turn (except Knockback).

name: laeline traveler
effect: When you activate a Trait or Art that effects an area, you may spend 2 Strain to teleport into an unoccupied space you can see inside of that area. If the Art is instantaneous you may choose to teleport before or after any effects take place.

name: hunter
effect: At the start of your turn, designate a creature you can see as your Prey. You may only have 1 creature as your Prey at a time. You and your Followers have +1 on Attack Sums and Contests against your Prey.

name: bloodhound
effect: You have Advantage when tracking a damaged creature and gain +1 Speed when moving towards a creature that is damaged or has a Debuff applied to them (such as Burn, Slow, Rooted, Stun, or Marked).

name: hidden paths
effect: While traveling through terrain you are familiar with you and allies spend half the time to get from one location to another, and gain +1d4 on Checks and Contests for any stealth or foraging rolls.

name: beastbound
effect:
You have bonded with a Beast Follower. The Beast has 2xNATURE+LEVEL Max Health, LEVEL Strain, 0 Dodge, 6 Speed, 1 Body or Mind (Your choice), 2 Nature, and 0 for all other Stats. The Beast has the Art 'track creature' and two Tier 1 Arts of your choice (it needs the stat in order to take an Art). It has the type Animal, can be ridden as a Mount, and a Bite ('Dagger'), Claws ('Mace'), or a Ram Attack ('Club').
- When you gain a stat increase the Beast gains +1 in a Sub-Stat of your choice. If the Beast was to go to 0 health they go unconscious instead of dying.

The Beast improves as you do gaining the following benefits when you hit certain Tiers.
- *Tier 2* - The Beast gains +1 Dodge and either a Spit Attack ('Short Bow') or +1 Speed.
- *Tier 3* - The Beast does +1 damage and learns an additional Tier 2 Art.
- *Tier 4* - The Beast rolls 4 Combat Dice (instead of 3).

When you gain Cloaked your Followers may gain Cloaked as well.
Additionally, While in terrain you are familiar with you and your Followers may stop moving for a minute to become Invisible until you move.

name: ??? (needs ooc)
effect: When you or a Follower spend Marked or Cloaked on an Attack gain +Nature damage, remove 3 Shielding then do damage, or apply Slow until the end of the targets next turn.

name: apex predator
effect:
You and your Followers get the following bonuses against Marked targets and your Prey (from the 'Hunter' Trait):
- +1 damage
- +1 Speed while moving towards the target.
- When you incapacitate or kill the target become Empowered or Cloaked for 1 hour.

name: cat burglar
effect:
You do not need Thieves' Tools to lockpick, and may spend 10 minutes and 2 Strain to make a copy of any non-magical key you have seen or felt.
Additionally, you make no noise while climbing or falling up to half your Speed, and you can climb using THIEVING instead of BODY.

name: assassin
effect:
When you spend Cloaked on an Attack you may increase the Attack's damage by a number of d4 equal to your FINENESS instead of +1d6. This must be announced before the target does a Dodge roll.
Additionally, If you kill or incapacitate a creature while Hidden or Invisible you do not lose Hidden or Invisible.

name: spell thief
effect: When you see a creature, other than yourself, activate an Art you may spend a Locked Dice to know it for 1 hour. You are able to know a number of Arts with this Trait up to SOUL+THIEVING+1 at a time.

name: illusionist
effect: Your Arts that create illusions can be activated without gestures or sounds, can be activated with +3 range, and last for twice as long.

name: eyes of the night
effect: You can see in poorly light areas as if they were illuminated up to 18 tiles away, and can see through Obscured or Darkened areas you created.

name: hidden power
effect: While you are Hidden or Invisible you may conceal the fact that you are activating a Trait or Art. The Trait or Art makes no noise (unless the it is designed to) and activating a non-damaging Trait or Art does not break you out of Hidden or Invisibility.

name: facade
effect: When you get Hit, you may spend a Locked Dice and 4 Strain to leave an illusionary clone in your place. You then take half damage (minimum of 1) and may move up to 3 tiles in any direction. (This may still provoke Overwatch Attacks.)

name: shadow shapes
effect: Your illusions are so real that they have physical form. These illusions only feel real and cannot interact with the world aside from touch (they cannot do damage, activate Arts, use Traits, etc). Physical illusions have 1 health.

name: master thief
effect: When you gain Cloaked you may spend 1 Strain to become Hidden as well.
